consumer: The frontend tile renderer asking 'should this tile be drawn with the remembered-but-not-currently-visible dimmed shading?'
scope: Per-tile map-memory display state distinguishing remembered-but-unseen (dimmed) from currently-visible (lit) from never-seen (unknown/black)
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_tiles, which writes ter/furn ids plus seen=map::pl_sees(p,radius); pl_sees computes raw line-of-sight visibility within a radius, not the avatar's map-memory display category
divergence: A tile the avatar previously explored and remembers but cannot currently see: the GUI dims it, yet pl_sees returns false there exactly as it does for a never-explored tile, so the exposed 'seen' value cannot produce the dimmed-vs-black distinction the shading requires
